title: Todd N NDE 6638
content: It was a hot summer day in Florida. I was a twelve year old boy who loved to skateboard and just fit in with the other kids on the block. My neighbors two houses down had two boys who were approximately three and six years older than I was. So, obviously, they hung out with even older kids, too. Well, we were all talking and skateboarding and doing tricks in the street, when they started to play-fight around me. I just stood and watched as they did this. Then one of the older boys, approximately sixteen years old, snuck up behind me and put me in a 'sleeper hold' (otherwise known as a 'choke hold.') I tried to get out of it, but I was far outmatched by the older, stronger boy. Within seconds, I was out! 'Out went the lights' for me! It's hard to explain what transpired next, but I was above everyone, like, say, ten feet or so, looking down. I didn't notice whether 'I' had a body or not. What I saw was like the view from a camera. I could see and hear them laughing, standing around me. I could see my body actually lying there on the road! But I wasn't in it! I felt no pain whatsoever. Actually I felt great! I was just in awe of seeing myself and trying to figure out how I got outside of myself. Trying to figure out why I and was able to see everything unfolding from a viewpoint above everyone! Then, poof! I was back in my body and awake. I felt refreshed and slowly got up off the hot road. Most of the kids were still just laughing at me. I'm sure they didn't realize how you can easily die within seconds from the technique that was used on me. I'm pretty sure I told one of the kids about this and he said it must have been a dream, so I naturally believed him, given that he was the older, wiser kid on the block. Can anyone tell me what happened to me on that day? I'd love to hear a researcher's understanding of my experience. I know what happened to me. It wasn't a dream, and I'm not crazy. I would love my questions answered by someone who knows these experiences, or anyone else that can explain it to me. Thank you very much.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported feeling no pain and 'felt great' and was 'in awe.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Put in a 'sleeper hold'/'choke hold' by an older boy while skateboarding.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred with an elevated viewpoint above the scene; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; then an abrupt return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experience consisted primarily of a brief out-of-body observation ('like the view from a camera') during a choke hold, followed by an abrupt return ('poof!').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'It's hard to explain what transpired next, but I was above everyone, like, say, ten feet or so, looking down.'; 'I could see my body actually lying there on the road! But I wasn't in it!'; 'Then, poof! I was back in my body and awake.'
